research.recommended_topic: 3 Free AI Prompts to Clear Campus Placement & Job Interviews (Resume + HR Mock Prep)
research.audience_problem: Indian college students and freshers are entering peak campus placement season stressed about ATS resume rejections and unexpected HR interview questions, but don't know how to prompt free AI tools like ChatGPT or Gemini effectively.
research.why_now: September marks the peak kickoff of campus placement season and entry-level hiring drives across Indian engineering, MBA, and degree colleges. Practical career hacks solve an immediate, high-anxiety problem today.
research.hook: Placement season shuru ho gaya aur resume shortlist nahi ho raha? 3 copy-paste AI prompts jo har final year student ko save karne chahiye.
supporting_points: Prompt 1: 'Job Description vs Resume ATS Gap Finder' to identify missing industry keywords before submitting applications.
Prompt 2: 'Hostile HR Interview Simulator' to practice tough behavioral questions (e.g., career gaps, salary expectations, why this company) directly in conversational mode.
Prompt 3: 'Star Method Project Rewriter' to turn basic college project bullets into high-impact metric-driven bullet points without lying.
Best tools to use for free: Gemini 1.5 Flash (for large document context) and ChatGPT free tier, completely zero-cost for hostel students.
trend_signals: September campus placement drives kicking off across Tier 1, 2, and 3 Indian universities
High engagement format on Indian tech Instagram: actionable carousel checklists with copy-paste prompts
Surging search intent for ATS resume builders and campus placement interview prep among Indian 18-24 demographics

research.reasoning: Today's UTC date is 2026-09-12 (even number), which mandates AI content according to brand strategy. September is prime placement season in India, making placement prep the most urgent, high-save, and high-share topic for the core 18-24 Indian student demographic.

carousel_outline: Slide 1 (Hook): 'Salary credited' SMS aate hi balance gayab? 4 practical money rules for young India.
Slide 2: Rule 1 - The 'Swiggy/Blinkit Tax'. Cap impulsive delivery spending with a weekly sub-wallet budget.
Slide 3: Rule 2 - Pay Yourself First. Set automated SIPs for Day 2 after salary, before weekend plans take over.
Slide 4: Rule 3 - The 48-Hour Cart Rule. Added that sneaker or gadget to your cart? Wait 2 days. 80% impulse vanishes.
Slide 5: Rule 4 - The Mauj-Masti UPI Account. Keep a separate zero-balance account for daily lifestyle expenses so you never dip into rent or savings.
Slide 6 (Summary & CTA): Summary checklist + Reminder to save this post before month-end panic sets in.
creation.caption:
Salary aati hai, party hoti hai, aur 10 tareekh tak sannaata. 🥲

Sound too familiar?

Smart budgeting doesn’t mean giving up cutting chai or weekend outings. It simply means taking control before UPI auto-pilots your entire bank balance away.

Swipe through 4 realistic rules designed for desi adulting. 💳✨

Konsa rule start karna sabse zaroori lag raha hai? Tell us below.
